_readme: Template for config.json. Copy this file and fill in your values. Keys starting with _ are for documentation only. This example uses OpenCode + OpenRouter/free endpoints; keys live in api_key.json.

cli_mode._comment_mode: Accepted: semi_attended | unattended. Anything else falls back to semi_attended.

seed_tasks: Review the repository's plans, ideas and todos. resolve what you can.

evolve._comment_enabled: Master switch for the harness-evolution loop. Must stay false until the §12.8 enablement gate is satisfied (see TODO.md §12.8).
evolve._comment_max_edits_per_iteration: Upper bound on governed proposals per evolve iteration (default 1).
evolve._comment_max_tokens_per_iteration: Upper bound on tokenizer-count consumption per iteration (default 0 = no cap).

token_budget._note: Per-endpoint buckets. OpenRouter does not share 4h or daily tokens with OpenCode.
Per-endpoint buckets. OpenCode does not share 4h or daily tokens with OpenRouter.

chat-model.description: Chat-tuned model example: flagged chat_capable so shell_developer uses the chat-JSON-table protocol automatically

token_budget._note: Defaults for endpoints that omit token_budget. Each endpoint has its own 4h and daily bucket; they do not share.

_background_agents_note: random_review defaults OFF (§16.1): peer review is map-first plus blast-radius on real changes. Set random_review: true to enable the periodic random pick-a-file feeder as an explicit override.

background_sweep._note: §16.2 long-horizon coverage sweep. When enabled the background pool periodically reviews the next uncovered chunk (~80-120 lines) per reviewer agent. Paused during a foreground developer session. Set enabled: false to disable in soak-only runs.

developer._note: shell = worktree + bash loop (workflow/shell_developer.py) using mini-swe-agent; edit_payload = legacy structured EditPayload flow

shell_developer._note_test_command: e.g. 'python -m pytest tests/ -x -q'. Non-zero exit discards the session unless on_test_failure=propose_anyway
shell_developer._note_model: null uses the orchestrator decision, then agent_model_preferences.developer. Chat-capable models (Gemini Enterprise chat / api.genai.mil, or any model flagged chat_capable in its endpoint config) are driven with the chat-JSON-table protocol: the session passes an append-only JSON row table and the model completes the next row, which mini-swe uses as the next bash command. Do not set json_table=off for those models unless you accept that they may never emit a bash fence.
shell_developer._note_json_table: auto = chat-capable models (chat_capable endpoint flag, or api.genai.mil) use the JSON step-table protocol; others use bash fences. on = force JSON step-table for every model; off = never use it (bash fences only). A shell turn that errors falls back to an edit_payload mutation in the same turn when a concrete file target is known; otherwise the shell error is returned and fallback_skipped=true.
shell_developer._note_no_change_stall_limit: Stall tripwire: consecutive no-change steps where the action repeated an already-run command or exited non-zero end the session as 'Stalled' without burning to step_limit. 0 disables the tripwire. Soak16: the model burned 30 calls replaying failed sed edits.
shell_developer._note_task_scope: Task-fiability pre-flight. auto = an untargeted task ('review the architecture') is run as an exploration session capped to explore_step_cap steps with a FINISH-with-summary note. strict = an untargeted task is skipped before any LLM call (session_exit='UntargetedTask').
shell_developer._note_explore_step_cap: Step budget for untargeted (exploratory) tasks when task_scope=auto.

llm._note: Set to true or use PRIZMFORGE_TEST_MODE=1 to disable real API calls
